image_description: A group of four Brown Pelicans standing on a rocky surface near water. The pelicans have characteristic long bills with gular pouches, brownish-grey plumage on the body and wings, and yellowish-white heads. The lighting is bright sunlight, casting strong shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible pelicans clearly display the massive bill structure with the distinctive hanging gular pouch attached to the lower mandible.

The necks are visibly long and exhibit the characteristic retracted S-curve posture.
The tails are largely obscured by the folded wings and the angle of the birds; clear verification of the wedge shape is not possible.
